shortDescription: Stacks up to 7 playable z-levels (3 up / 3 down) into ONE banded RimWorld Map joined by synthetic RegionLink wormholes, so hauling, needs, work and storage come free from vanilla. Cross-level combat, senses, NPC travel, CE bridge (experimental), "Traveler" climb animations, blueprint art, wall risers, research-gated links, a per-colony off switch, Perspective Shift + Toggleable Overlays support. Workshop 3776015553. ⚠ WINDOW 11 IS ALL FIELD-VERIFIED AND THE MOD FOLDER IS CURRENTLY STRIPPED FOR UPLOAD.
body:
**NOTE TO SELF:** running spec, not a changelog. §0 handover; §1-19 architecture; §20 compat; §21-29 bug records; §30 SUPERSEDED by §62; §31 publishing + GIT; §32-40 records; §41-44 combat/senses/travel/CE; §45-50 field-report fixes; §51 Celestial Lighting; §52 field-report round 2; §53 arrival/landing; §54 structure fit; §55 exit grid; §56 Geological Landforms; §57 stale decoration window; §58 relocated-structure fog; §59 forbid-aware islands; §60 area-linear vanilla systems; §61 camera-mod coexistence; §62 utility COLUMN rework + §62.N; §63 stairs permission; §64 cross-level shadow depth; §65 forbidden mirroring; §66 aim/wild-miss/aim-pie; §67 boulder extrusion; §68 KCSG/VFEM2; §69 stair temperature; §70 band flora legality + §70.B (OPEN); §71 Smooth Terrain (RESOLVED; report awaiting paste); §72 link gizmos; §73 transit animations (SUPERSEDED); §74 blueprint art; §75 wall risers; §76 Perspective Shift; §77 motion study + §77b railing bug + §77c art defects; **§78 pre-hop delay + climb grammar, VERIFIED run #374**; **§79 Toggleable Overlays, VERIFIED run #374**; **§80 research gating, VERIFIED run #373**; **§81 multiple-levels checkbox, VERIFIED run #373**. Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE. DATED SOURCE BACKUPS LIVE AT `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). The old note "V1 survives only in git history pre-a50a744" was WRONG and cost a re-derivation. These are `Source/` only - no Defs, no Textures. **When a V2 feature has a V1 ancestor, READ THE V1 FILE FIRST.** Confirmed useful: `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs` (§78d). Tool boundary: `read` refuses that path, `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it fine.

# 0. START HERE

**⚠⚠⚠ THE MOD FOLDER IS STRIPPED RIGHT NOW. `Source/`, `Tools/`, `docs/`, `.git/`, `mockups/` AND `.gitignore` ARE NOT HERE.** They are at:

`C:\Users\Astryl\AppData\Roaming\Modmixer\workspace\publish-staging\AsAboveSoBelow2-w11\`

**Until they are moved back: `build_mod` cannot work, git cannot work, and the checklist and change notes are not readable from the mod folder.** If a session opens and `Source/` is missing, THIS IS WHY - restore the six before doing anything else. The staging dir is OUTSIDE `Mods/`, which is required (anything inside `Mods/` gets scanned by the game).

**CURRENT PHASE: WINDOW 11, MID-PUBLISH.** Everything before the upload is done:
- **All four window-11 features are FIELD-VERIFIED.** §80/§81 on run #373; **§78d and §79 on run #374** (Toggleable Overlays loaded as a companion, 4-band map, user confirmed "all works"). Both runs captured **zero** bridge errors. This is the first window in a while with nothing shipped blind.
- **Release build** 0w/0e; `Assemblies/` holds only `AsAboveSoBelow.dll`; no pdb, no obj/bin, no csproj, no .cs, no 0Harmony anywhere in the ship list.
- **Log hygiene audited:** all six `Log.Message` sites gated (`ABLog.Dev`/verboseLogging, two on `GeologicalLandformsCompat.DiagEnabled`, a `[DebugAction]`, an explicit button, and the sky-sync repair line which is a real-fault diagnostic).
- **Metadata:** name, `astryl.AsAboveSoBelow2`, supportedVersions 1.6, PublishedFileId **3776015553** present, Harmony dep + `incompatibleWith` intact, `Preview.png` present.
- **Change notes** written for window 11 and em-dash-checked; they are at `<staging>/docs/UPDATE_NOTES.txt`.
- **Pushed as `c095e92`** on origin/main BEFORE the strip.

**⚠ WHAT IS LEFT, IN ORDER:** (1) Run the Modmixer **publish utility**. (2) Paste `<staging>/docs/UPDATE_NOTES.txt` into the Steam **WEB** editor Change Notes (the utility uploads FILES + PREVIEW ONLY). (3) **MOVE THE SIX BACK.** (4) **WORKSHOP SMOKE TEST** from the WORKSHOP copy - never done for any window.

**⚠ SHIP LIST AS EYEBALLED:** `.modmixer/` (utility excludes it), `About/` (About.xml, ModIcon.png, Preview.png, PublishedFileId.txt, known-issues.json), `Assemblies/AsAboveSoBelow.dll`, `Defs/`, `Languages/`, `Textures/`, `LICENSE`, `LoadFolders.xml`. **`About/known-issues.json` has shipped unchanged since window 8** - not a regression, but nobody has ever confirmed it is meant to go up.

**⚠ ABOUT.XML DESCRIPTION IS STALE** and is the USER'S COPY - not to be edited during publish prep. It does not mention research gating or the per-colony off switch, and "You pick the shape at colony start" is now also "or no levels at all". Flagged, not fixed.

**⚠ WORKSPACE DLL IS A RELEASE BUILD** as of this prep. It reverts to DEBUG the moment `build_mod` runs again.

**⚠ STILL OWED AFTER THIS WINDOW:** **FINAL riser art** (Gemini PAUSED r5; ⚠ REWRITE prompts to the REAL palette - NO copper: power=steel+blue+hazard, pipe=pale+red valve, climate=ice+louver+orange, data=black+purple+cyan). **FOREIGN PRINT-PATH AUDIT** (ledger 4). **§77c ART** - grand staircase east/west sprites unrotated; user's domain. §62.N formal line. Smooth Terrain upstream paste. §70 Caverns verify. Delete the retired ghost stubs. **AnimationDef pipeline port** (§78d, OFFERED NOT ACCEPTED).

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (earlier windows, still true):** §62.N, §70 (w8); §62.M, §66c, §66e (w7). **⚠ PLACEHOLDER ART:** the 12 riser PNGs, by explicit user decision.

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked - scans COMPAT ONLY. **V1 is OUR OWN prior work and is exempt: porting from it is explicitly wanted.** (2) Building art = USER via Nano Banana kits. (3) About.xml description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N CHOICES.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE FORTY-NINE RULES:** 1. CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2. NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3. REGION CONNECTIVITY IS MORE OPTIMISTIC THAN THE PATHFINDER: flood CELLS. 4. COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/ENGINE STACKS. 5 (§48): A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 (§49): A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP INSTEAD OF AN ERROR. 7 (§52): THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 (§52.6): A LOAD-TIME REPAIR PASS MUST NEVER RE-CREATE WHAT THE PLAYER DELIBERATELY REMOVED. 9 (§53): SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 (§54): A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 (§55): A CELL-LEVEL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN-LEVEL ACTION. 12 (§56a): A FOREIGN MOD'S MAP-SIZE SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT. 13 (§56g): NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 (§56m): BEFORE RELOCATING DATA, ASK WHAT IS ALREADY AT THE DESTINATION. 15 (§57i): ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST. 16 (§56o): COUNT THE FOREIGN MOD'S WRITE PATHS. 17 (§56q): A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX. 18 (§57a): NEVER EXONERATE A SUSPECT ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 (§57f): `TicksGame` RESTARTS AT 0 EVERY NEW GAME. 20 (§57g): MOVING WORK EARLIER TURNS ON EVERY "IS THIS MAP READY" GATE. 21 (§58): THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL WITH THE CONTENT. 22 (§59): A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN IN IT. 23 (§60): AUDIT THE WEIGHTING, NOT THE SYMBOL. 24 (§61a): CLAMPING A VALUE WITHOUT CLAMPING ITS TARGET BUILDS AN OSCILLATOR. 25 (§61b): A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS AFTER THE OBJECT WAS ALREADY POSITIONED. 26 (§61f): EVERY READ OF THE MAP THE PLAYER CAN REACH MUST PASS THE RENDERER'S "IS IT DRAWN" GATE. 27 (§62c): PREFER SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 (§63a): A PERMANENT FICTION INSTALLED FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS READ AS FACT BY EVERY OTHER ONE. 29 (§0b): REPORT OUTCOMES, NOT INTENTIONS. 30 (§66d): A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN, NOT A NUMBER. 31 (§66f): MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE DECLINED. 32 (§69a): TURNING OFF A TICK TURNS OFF EVERY SERVICE THAT RODE ON IT. 33 (§62k): A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO. 34 (§62l): AN INVISIBLE THING IS ABSENT FROM EVERY SECTION LAYER. 35 (§62n): A CLONED FOREIGN DEF MADE VISIBLE IS IN NONE OF THE HOST'S OWN LOOKUPS. 36 (§70a): RUN VANILLA'S OWN LEGALITY PREDICATE. 37 (§71a): NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT BEFORE NAMING THE SYMPTOM. 38 (§73): WHEN A SPRITE MUST APPEAR AWAY FROM ITS THING'S POSITION, OWN THE DRAW. 39 (§76): WINNING THE LAST WRITE DOES NOT SETTLE A DISAGREEMENT ABOUT THE TARGET. 40 (§75.h): A TRIPWIRE THAT FIRES BEFORE THE OBSERVER ATTACHES IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 (§77a): A STRUCT FIELD YOU NEVER SET IS A FEATURE YOU NEVER SHIPPED. 42 (§77b): THE DIRECTION A MOTION READS AS IS A PROPERTY OF THE THING, NOT OF THE ARRIVAL - and the far end is a DIFFERENT thing with its own axis. 43 (§78): **DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION.** 44 (§78b): AN OFFSET APPLIED WHOLE ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT, AND EVERY `DrawPos`-DERIVED OVERLAY STAYS BEHIND. 45 (§78d): **A DIRECTION OF TRAVEL IS NOT A DIRECTION OF ELEVATION.** 46 (§78d): **NON-UNIFORM SCALE x ROTATION = SHEAR.** Squash-and-stretch OR lean, never both. 47 (§79): **A FOREIGN MOD'S CACHED CURSOR CELL IS AN ASSUMPTION ABOUT COORDINATE SPACE.** Substitute the cell around our pass instead of re-patching its N gates. 48 (§81a): **A WRITE THAT IS READ BACK BY ITS OWN CALLER IS NOT A WRITE.** `Window.WindowOnGUI` does `windowRect = GUI.Window(ID, windowRect, ...)` - it passes the old rect in and assigns the result back AFTER the callback, so a windowRect set from inside `DoWindowContents` is clobbered in the same frame with no error. 49 (§0c): **A TEST THAT PROVES FEATURE A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT FEATURE B, AND "TESTS GOOD" IS NOT A SCOPE.** Run #373 verified §80/§81 and, by generating the single-level map the §81 script asked for, structurally could not touch §78d; §79 could not have run at all because Toggleable Overlays was not in the session. Both needed run #374 with a companion mod and a banded map. Name the features a run exercised, at the time, and check the modlist before believing a compat feature was covered.

Commit and push BEFORE the strip. **⚠ `.gitignore` travels with `.git/` and was caught in the ship list once (window 9); it is in the loop now.** **Window 11 state: pushed `c095e92`, strip DONE, utility not yet run, six items awaiting restore.**

# 74. BLUEPRINT ART — SHIPPED w10, USER-VERIFIED

`ABBlueprintLook` retint; `Blueprint_ABBuild` stuff tint; `ABGhostGraphicForLinks` IsDoor bypass. Single knob, consumed in TWO places (blueprint `GraphicData.color` AND `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor`, which must re-apply it over the stuff colour or a stuffed plan comes back opaque). **§74.b:** 0.70 read as ALREADY BUILT; now **0.42**. **⚠ §74.c: THE KNOB IS NO LONGER A CONST.** `DefaultBlueprintAlpha` = 0.42 is the fallback; `BlueprintAlpha` is a mutable static driven by `ApplyAlpha(float)`, which also rewrites each retinted def's `GraphicData.color` and NULLS `GraphicData.cachedGraphic` (nothing public invalidates it). Stuffed links need none of that - `Blueprint_ABBuild.DrawColor` reads the field per draw.

4 defs; a riser IS a `Building_ABColumn`; WallLamp attachment; no `holdsRoof`; cascade despawn. uiOrder: links 2060-2066, columns 2070-2073, risers 2080-2083. **§75.g `AB2: carrier probe`** - per-cell drawerType/IsCarrier/ShouldPrint census plus a live Harmony patch census. **Keep this tool.** **§75.h:** Dubwise layers derive from plain `SectionLayer`, declare NO `TakePrintFrom`, print from `Building_Pipe.PrintForGrid`; patched per host, deduped by MethodInfo, prefix INSPECTS the `SectionLayer` argument so unrecognised layers print rather than hide (rule 34). **⚠ §75.f IS PARTLY SUPERSEDED BY §80** - the architect ORDER note stands, the "no researchPrerequisites" note does not.

Cross-band shooting needed no code: PS gates on `verb.CanHitTarget`, which funnels through our `TryFindShootLineFromTo` patch. **⚠ NOT re-tested since §78 changed transit timing** - ledger 9.

# 77. MOTION STUDY ROUND 2 — CLOSED. TRAVELER PICKED.

Five languages in `mockups/anim-A..E-*.html` over a shared kit. **User picked C - Traveler at 0.30 playback** and asked for the delay to move BEFORE the hop. **D's structure-animation track (the building reacts) is the one unused idea worth revisiting.**

**⚠ §77a FACING (rule 41).** `PawnDrawParms.facing` is a writable `Rot4` on the struct our GetDrawParms postfix already takes by ref. **⚠ ALPHA: NO.** pawn materials are cutout; alpha needs `PawnRenderFlags.Invisible` → `InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat`, a distortion shader with a hard-coded cyan multiply. Scale is the only vanish channel.

**§77b THE RAILING BUG, BOTH ENDS.** Every `*_south` sprite has its notch on its **NORTH** edge. **Entry edge = `Opposite(Rotation)`, run direction = `Rotation.FacingCell`.** ⚠ **The counterpart shares this end's `Rotation` and that is load-bearing** (`GenAdj.AdjustForRotation`; `TryCellPairs` pairs cell i to cell i) - **DO NOT FLIP IT**.

**⚠ §77c ART DEFECTS - USER'S DOMAIN.** (a) `AB_GrandStairsDown/Up_east`/`_west` are the NORTH composition unrotated. (b) `AB_StairsDown_east/_west` differ in composition and sit 0.42 cells north. (c) `AB_StairsUp_east/_west` have no notch on any edge. (d) `AB_LadderUp_east` is a 0.14-cell sliver drawn 0.30 cells west. `ABStairAnim.ArtOffsets` transcribes these honestly.

# 78. PRE-HOP DELAY + THE V1 CLIMB GRAMMAR — VERIFIED IN FIELD, RUN #374

**Structure.** `Carry` splits into `BeginCrossing` / `TickCrossings` / `CarryNow`. Both teleport sites (tick sweep AND `TryConsumeArrival`) route through it.

**⚠⚠ WHY THIS IS NOT RUN #297 (rule 43).** #297 held the pawn by REFUSING AN ARRIVAL, so `PatherArrived` never ran, the leg never completed, the job re-issued `StartPath`, `TrySegment` re-segmented forever. **The DECISION was deferred behind a cosmetic condition.** §78 defers only the POSITION WRITE: the record has already left `pending` and `everSegmented`, so there is no leg to re-segment. Held by **`StopDead()` + `StaggerFor`** - StopDead clears `moving` WITHOUT notifying the JobDriver, so the toil waits and `PatherTick` never re-tests `AtDestinationPosition`. Every exit teleports or abandons; anchor lost → `EndCurrentJob`; job changed → cancel, no teleport; moved off the hold cell → fire early; `MaxHoldTicks` 300 backstops. **Four field rounds now, no stuck pawns, no bridge errors.**

**§78b (round 1).** The clip is authored about the LINK but nothing put the pawn AT the link. (1) absolute snap → `travelX/travelZ` scaled by pose easing. (2) label postfix on `GenMapUI.LabelDrawPosFor(Thing, float)`; ⚠ delta in SCREEN space, y term subtracts. (3) facing from the actual vector. (4) `EntryCellFor` rewrites the path destination.

**§78c (round 2).** The sweep carried any pawn within 3 cells, so the clip began mid-walk. `EntryCellFor` now returns the footprint cell just inside the notch - ⚠ tested with **`Walkable`, not `Standable`** (a `Building_Door` is `PassThroughOnly`). ⚠⚠ Narrowing the carry condition has jammed stairwells every previous time, so it is **delayed, never denied**: three triggers (on the cell / stopped short / 120-tick backstop).

**§78d (round 3), PORTED FROM V1 `Source/Stairs/ClimbAnimation.cs`:** SLIDE toward centre capped 1.35; BOB on TICKS (period 12/16, amp 0.05/0.08); **VERT z −0.35 down / +0.30 up**, the actual fix; SCALE ×0.72 / ×1.10, **uniform**; LEAN `Sin(t*PI/24)*3°` stairs only; EMERGE 22 ticks ease-out, vertical INVERTED against the climb; durations 90 (ladder 110, elevator 90 + 16/level capped 130). **⚠ OFFERED, NOT ACCEPTED: THE PIPELINE.** V1 used native `AnimationDef` + `BaseAnimationWorker` and checked `renderer.CurAnimation` to never stomp a foreign animation - strictly better for compat with Yayo's/Melee Animation. Ledger 12. **⚠ RETIRED STUBS:** `IsGhosting` returns constant false, `DrawGhosts` is a no-op; **§78 is proven now, so delete them.**

# 79. TOGGLEABLE OVERLAYS — VERIFIED IN FIELD, RUN #374

Bridge to `Owlchemist.ToggleableOverlays` (ws 3261316725). Reflection-only, no foreign type in any signature, inert and silent when absent. Reads via Harmony `FieldRef`, NOT `FieldInfo.GetValue` - two sit on a per-frame path once profiled at 1.41 ms. **Bound shape:** `ToggleableOverlaysUtility.mousePositionX/mousePositionZ/mousePosition/quickView`; `ModSettings_ToggleableOverlays.hideForbidden/hideForbiddenBuildings/optimizedLister/zoomFilter/blueprintTransparency`; `Mod_ToggleableOverlays.WriteSettings`. The mouse trio is load-bearing; everything else degrades to "that toggle is off".

**⚠ 79.1 THE COORDINATE-SPACE BUG (rule 47).** Every one of TO's ~10 gates is `thing.positionInt == mousePosition` against a cell derived from a raw `ScreenPointToRay` - the VIEW band's cell. A below-band thing lives at `z - drop` and can never equal it, so no below overlay is reachable by hover; with TO's defaults that silently deletes stack counts, storage labels, bed names and fuel warnings from every lower level. **Fix = ONE substitution:** `PushBelowMouse` saves their three fields and points them at the cell the hovered column actually shows; `PopMouse` restores in a `finally`. ⚠ Read FROM THEIR OWN FIELDS, not `UI.MouseCell`. ⚠ Off-map/opaque/`drop == 0` parks at `IntVec3.Invalid` (rule 28). ⚠ The `finally` is non-negotiable.

**79.2 FORBIDDEN MARKERS.** Our X is a bare `Graphics.DrawMesh` and never enters `RenderForbiddenOverlay` where TO's transpiler lives. `AllowForbiddenBelow` re-implements their check: `quickView` ⇒ true; neither setting ⇒ true; **their zoom gate applies to EVERY category once either setting is on**; `Item` ⇒ cell compare; `Building`/`Ethereal` ⇒ `GenAdj.IsInside`. Settings read LIVE (their `WriteSettings` does `UnpatchAll` + `PatchAll`, so theirs are live too).

**79.3 ZOOM CULLING — THEIR SLIDER WINS.** `BelowOverlayGroup` mirrors their `HasGUIOverlay`→`Pawn` swap, falling back to `HasGUIOverlay` when TO is absent or a binding failed.

**79.4 BLUEPRINT ALPHA — THEIR SLIDER WINS (rule 39), AND IT SHIPPED THAT WAY.** Their `WriteSettings` walks every blueprint def and writes `graphic.color.a`, from their static ctor AND on every settings close; racing them is unwinnable, so we ADOPT via a postfix calling `ABBlueprintLook.ApplyAlpha`. **⚠ THEIR SLIDER DEFAULTS TO 1.0**, so a TO user who never opens TO's settings gets fully opaque plans. Field-checked in run #374 and accepted as-is; the change notes tell TO users which slider to turn down. One line reverses it if that ever comes back as a report: `Mathf.Min(theirs, DefaultBlueprintAlpha)`.

**79.5 NOT BRIDGED, DELIBERATELY.** Their progress-bar/fillable-bar patches gate on the same cursor cell; we never redraw a below-band fillable bar. Ledger 13.

# 80. RESEARCH GATING — VERIFIED IN FIELD, RUN #373

Four free-standing `ResearchProjectDef`s, no prerequisites of their own, by explicit user decision. `AB2_Stairs` (400, Neolithic, ClassicStart) gates stairs up/down **and both grand staircases**; `AB2_Ladders` (400, Neolithic, ClassicStart) gates the ladders; `AB2_TransferColumns` (1200, Industrial) gates the 4 columns **and the 4 wall risers**; `AB2_ElevatorTech` (1600, Industrial) gates the elevator.

**80.1 WHERE THE PREREQUISITE IS STATED.** Per-def on `AB2_StairsDown`/`AB2_StairsUp` (their shared `AB2_LinkBase` also parents the ladders and elevator, so a base-level statement would gate all seven on one project), and on the abstract bases `AB2_GrandBase`, `AB2_LadderBase`, `AB_ColumnBase`, `AB_WallRiserBase`.

**⚠ 80.2 THE PROJECT IS `AB2_ElevatorTech`, NOT `AB2_Elevator`.** defNames are unique per DefType only, so a project of that name would legally coexist with the ThingDef and make every log line and xpath ambiguous. Player-facing label is still "elevator".

**⚠ 80.3 THIS PARTLY REVERSES §75.f, AND THE OLD REASONING SURVIVES.** §75.f removed prerequisites because Electricity + Machining locked a fresh colony out of its own utilities until mid game. `AB2_TransferColumns` has NO prerequisites, so that is answered by construction. Per-network toggles still consult each host mod's research (`AB2_ColumnNeedsResearch`). §75.f's uiOrder note is untouched. **⚠ The window-10 change notes announced "columns no longer need research"; window 11 walks it back one update later, and the notes say so plainly.**

**⚠ 80.4 TRIBAL STARTS BEGIN WITH NO WAY DOWN.** `PlayerColony` lists ClassicStart in `startingResearchTags`; `PlayerTribe` does not, so a tribal colony must spend 400 before it can leave its level. Deliberate, reversible with one `<li>TribalStart</li>`.

**⚠ 80.5 ROW 6.40 IS AN EMPTY ROW TODAY.** Tallest vanilla project across Core + all DLCs is 5.70. Recheck if a DLC extends the tree downward.

# 81. "ENABLE MULTIPLE LEVELS" CHECKBOX — VERIFIED IN FIELD, RUN #373

A checkbox on the **Levels** heading row of `Dialog_AdvancedGameConfig`, collapsing the bottom strip, backed by scribed `ABSettings.multiLevel` (default true).

**81.1 IT SUSPENDS THE PLAN, IT DOES NOT ERASE IT.** `upperLevels`/`lowerLevels` keep the player's choice; `ABMapSizeLimit.MultiLevel` gates only the EFFECTIVE counts, which read 0. `BandCount` collapses to 1 and `Patch_MapGenerator_GenerateMap` takes its pre-existing "single level - ordinary map" branch, so **no new generation path was added**.

**81.2 IT ALSO HANDS BACK THE MAP-SIZE COLUMN.** `Active` now includes `MultiLevel`: unticked ⇒ `Fits` unconditional, `Clamp` identity, `BeginChooser` returns before locking or relabelling, the every-frame snap stops. On tick-OFF `mapSize` is forced to **250** or vanilla's radio column comes back with nothing selected. Tick-ON needs no counterpart - `Active` is live and the existing snap clamps onto the ladder the same frame. `AB_MapSizeLockedTip` now opens "Locked by the multiple levels setting:".

**⚠ 81.3 THE WINDOW RESIZE (rule 48).** A `windowRect` written from the chooser is clobbered by `windowRect = GUI.Window(ID, windowRect, ...)` in the same frame, silently. The rect is parked in a static and applied by `Patch_Window_ABResizeAfterDraw`, a postfix on base `Window.WindowOnGUI` - on every window's draw path, so its first line is a `ReferenceEquals` bail with nothing allocated above it. (`resizeLater` would work but is gated on `resizeable`, which adds a user-draggable handle.)

**⚠ 81.4 LAY OUT AGAINST THE HEIGHT YOU WERE GRANTED.** `InitialSize` is consulted once by `SetInitialSizeAndPosition`, so the checkbox cannot change height by itself. The strip anchors from `GrantedStripHeight`; `WantedStripHeight` is 240 expanded / 44 collapsed; window = `vanilla + granted + StripPadding(48)`. Ticking ON inside a 44px window draws the collapsed row for **one frame** rather than punching through vanilla's columns.
